# Smtp2go

SMTP2GO is a reliable email delivery service that ensures your emails reach recipients' inboxes efficiently.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/smtp2go/.

## Actions

- **Add Allowed Sender**: Add a new allowed sender email address.
- **Add IP Allow List**: Add an ip address or cidr range to your account’s ip allow list.
- **Add Sender Domain**: Add a new sender domain for spf/dkim verification.
- **Add SMTP User**: Add a new smtp user.
- **Add to Suppression List**: Add email addresses or domains to the suppression list.
- **Add Webhook**: Create a new webhook.
- **Edit Email Template**: Edit details of an existing email template.
- **Edit SMTP User**: Edit details of an existing smtp user.
- **Edit Webhook**: Edit an existing webhook’s settings.
- **Email Cycle Statistics**: Retrieve email cycle statistics.
- **Email History Statistics**: Retrieve email history statistics.
- **Email Spam Statistics**: Retrieve email spam report statistics.
- **Email Unsubscription Stats**: Retrieve email unsubscribe statistics.
- **Get Email Bounces Stats**: Retrieve email bounces statistics.
- **Remove Allowed Sender**: Remove a sender email address from the allowed senders list.
- **Remove IP from Allow List**: Remove an ip address from your account's ip allow list.
- **Remove SMTP User**: Remove an smtp user from your account.
- **Remove suppression entry**: Remove an email address or domain from the suppression list.
- **Remove webhook**: Remove a webhook.
- **Search Email Activity**: Search activity events like sends, opens, clicks, and bounces.
- **Search Email Templates**: Search your collection of email templates by id or name.
- **Search SMTP2GO Emails**: Search sent emails.
- **Search Subaccounts**: Search subaccounts.
- **Subaccounts Usage**: Retrieve usage statistics for subaccounts.
- **Update Allowed Sender**: Update details of an existing allowed sender.
- **View Allowed Senders**: View the list of allowed senders configured in your account.
- **View Email Template**: View details of a specific email template.
- **View IP Allow List**: View the list of ip addresses in your ip allow list.
- **View Received SMS**: Retrieve received sms replies for your smtp2go account.
- **View SMTP Users**: List all smtp users configured on your account.
- **View Suppression List**: View the suppression list.
- **View Webhooks**: View all webhooks configured in your account.
